passage.text: Nam's cousin Kwan works in the marketing department of a big company in Bangkok.
passage.reading: ˈnɑːmz ˈkʌzən ˈkwɑːn ˈwɜːrks ɪn ðə ˈmɑːrkɪtɪŋ dɪˈpɑːrtmənt əv ə ˈbɪɡ ˈkʌmpəni ɪn ˈbæŋkɑːk.

passage.text: Last month, her manager sent an email to all two hundred employees about the company's New Year party.
passage.reading: ˈlæst ˈmʌnθ, hɜːr ˈmænɪdʒər ˈsɛnt ən ˈiːmeɪl tu ˈɔːl ˈtuː ˈhʌndrəd ɪmˈplɔɪiːz əˈbaʊt ðə ˈkʌmpəniz ˈnuː ˈjɪr ˈpɑːrti.

passage.text: Kwan's friend Oil forwarded it to her with a message: "Are you going? I hear the boss is going to sing again!"
passage.reading: ˈkwɑːnz ˈfrɛnd ˈɔɪl ˈfɔːrwərdɪd ɪt tə hɜːr wɪð ə ˈmɛsɪdʒ: ər juː ˈɡoʊɪŋ? aɪ ˈhɪr ðə ˈbɔːs ɪz ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈsɪŋ əˈɡɛn!

passage.text: Kwan laughed and quickly wrote back: "Only if he sings just one song! His voice is terrible!"
passage.reading: ˈkwɑːn ˈlæft ənd ˈkwɪkli ˈroʊt ˈbæk: ˈoʊnli ɪf hiː ˈsɪŋz dʒʌst ˈwʌn ˈsɔːŋ! hɪz ˈvɔɪs ɪz ˈtɛrəbəl!

passage.text: Then she clicked "send" and went to make some coffee.
passage.reading: ˈðɛn ʃiː ˈklɪkt ˈsɛnd ənd ˈwɛnt tə ˈmeɪk sʌm ˈkɔːfi.

passage.text: When she came back, she had twenty new messages.
passage.reading: wɛn ʃiː ˈkeɪm ˈbæk, ʃiː ˈhæd ˈtwɛnti ˈnuː ˈmɛsɪdʒɪz.

passage.text: To her horror, she realized that she had clicked "reply all."
passage.reading: tə hɜːr ˈhɔːrər, ʃiː ˈriːəlaɪzd ðæt ʃiː hæd ˈklɪkt rɪˈplaɪ ˈɔːl.

passage.text: Her email had gone to all two hundred employees, including her manager.
passage.reading: hɜːr ˈiːmeɪl hæd ˈɡɔːn tu ˈɔːl ˈtuː ˈhʌndrəd ɪmˈplɔɪiːz, ɪnˈkluːdɪŋ hɜːr ˈmænɪdʒər.

passage.text: She tried to undo it, but it was too late.
passage.reading: ʃiː ˈtraɪd tu ʌnˈduː ɪt, bʌt ɪt wʌz ˈtuː ˈleɪt.

passage.text: Some people had already forwarded it to their friends.
passage.reading: sʌm ˈpiːpəl hæd ɔːlˈrɛdi ˈfɔːrwərdɪd ɪt tə ðɛr ˈfrɛndz.

passage.text: A few minutes later, her manager walked into her office.
passage.reading: ə ˈfjuː ˈmɪnɪts ˈleɪtər, hɜːr ˈmænɪdʒər ˈwɔːkt ˈɪntuː hɜːr ˈɔːfɪs.

passage.text: Kwan was terrified, but he was smiling.
passage.reading: ˈkwɑːn wʌz ˈtɛrəfaɪd, bʌt hiː wʌz ˈsmaɪlɪŋ.

passage.text: "You're right," he said. "My voice is terrible. But I'm going to sing at the party anyway!"
passage.reading: jʊr ˈraɪt, hiː ˈsɛd. maɪ ˈvɔɪs ɪz ˈtɛrəbəl. bʌt aɪm ˈɡoʊɪŋ tə ˈsɪŋ ət ðə ˈpɑːrti ˈɛniweɪ!

passage.text: These days, Kwan and her manager laugh about it.
passage.reading: ðiːz ˈdeɪz, ˈkwɑːn ənd hɜːr ˈmænɪdʒər ˈlæf əˌbaʊt ɪt.

passage.text: But she always checks twice before she clicks "send."
passage.reading: bʌt ʃiː ˈɔːlweɪz ˈtʃɛks ˈtwaɪs bɪˈfɔːr ʃiː ˈklɪks ˈsɛnd.
